    BO13a Lemma 6, case II #

    Neither ρₙ nor σ₂ is long (MulBasis.l6_caseII). By Lemma 5 a), ρₙ factors through the last arrow of u₂ or of w, and σ₂ through the last arrow of u₂' or of w':

    • ρₙ through w: case II.A (l6_caseIIA); σ₂ through w': case II.A for L6Data.swap;
    • otherwise case II.C: figure 6.1 if neither factors through all of u₂ resp. u₂'; l6_IIC_β (or its swap) if exactly one does; if both do (l6_IIC_α), figure 6.14, whose failure gives a crown of length four, so n = 2 by minimality and l6_IIC_αend applies.

    FactorsThroughMorphism τ (C.toZChain.σ (r + 1)) ∨ FactorsThroughMorphism τ (C.toZChain.ρ (r + 2))

    In a crown of length four whose ρₙ = ρ (r+1) and σ₂ = σ (r+2) are not long, every long morphism divides σ (r+1) or ρ (r+2).
